Team —

Quick context: StormTech (late-stage prospect, deal ST-9021) is in procurement next week and asked for a short customer call to validate fit on two critical points: 1) low-latency live scoring for transaction streams (~50–100ms p95) and 2) private / VPC deployment with strict audit logs. They asked specifically for peers in the fintech / payments vertical, US-based, and who went live with production traffic in the last 9–12 months.

Elena (CC'd) is the procurement lead — Elena, they are sensitive about scale and want to make sure we have references who saw real cost/latency benefits after switching to Redwood Dedicated or Private. Ideal call is 30 minutes next week (preferred Wed/Thu mornings PST).

Ask: can we surface 1–2 advocates that match the vertical + deployment profile and are comfortable on a 30-minute call next week? If you have a short one-pager or case snippet, attach it so I can send over to Elena.

Priority: high — this is a final procurement check. I can own coordination once you confirm names.

Thanks,

Elena / Mina —

I can line up two customers who are a close fit and have agreed to a short call about their Dedicated/Private deployments. High-level: both are US-based fintechs running production live scoring. Short bios below; attaching one-pagers.

1) BrightBank — mid-market bank, moved to Redwood Dedicated June 2026. Live scoring for fraud detection; reported p95 latency improvement from ~220ms to ~85ms after we tuned batching and turned on KV prefix caching. They have SOC2 and used our VPC deployment with KMS integration. Primary contact: Priya Suresh (Head of Engineering) — happy to join the call.

2) Ledgerly — payments orchestration for merchant networks; went on-prem/private for compliance in Q1 2026. They handled a 3-week pilot with real traffic and saw a 45% token-cost reduction while holding p95 < 120ms. Primary contact: Mark Huang (SRE lead).

Attachments: brightbank-advocate-onepager.pdf, ledgerly-advocate-summary.docx

Availability: Both can do Wed 11/3 10:00–10:40am PST (30 min + 10 min buffer). If that works, Mina can send calendar invite / dial-in.
